d: "You won't believe what's hiding inside these houses! From unexpected animal visitors to wild creatures making themselves at home, Team Turtle is answering some of the strangest wildlife rescue calls yet. This compilation brings together the best moments from Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and his trusted partner Neal James as they take on unusual animal rescue and capture missions. Whether it's snake catching, raccoon catching, turtle catching or mink catching, every encounter brings a new challenge. Watch these animal rescuers put their wild animal catching skills to the…
